act5/camp/frost_camp.title: Embers Under the Storm
act5/camp/frost_camp.body:
Pilgrims **share** warmth in pieces; the fire consumes. No one climbs whole.

*No calendar in the storm: **day {{day}}**.* If the wind allows, there is still time to talk.

choices.text: Rest by the brazier (−1 supply)
choices.lockedHint: You need at least 1 supply to pay for rest.

choices.text: Use a consumable
choices.preview: Choose which potion to use.

choices.text: Exchange a few words with the group
Manage equipment at camp
Share a prayer with devotees of the Third Bell
choices.preview: +1 faith, +1 corruption (once)
diaryTexts: The embers drew an invisible bell — no one struck it, but everyone heard.

choices.text: Ask the Vigil for escort of thought (against the Cult)
choices.preview: Cult falls; Vigil rises (slow) (once)
diaryTexts: A cloak-bearer traced a line in the snow between me and the rumor of the bell.

choices.text: Consecrate melted snow as holy water (cleric)
choices.preview: −1 supply · +2 faith (once)
diaryTexts: I melted snow in the staff's tin until my hand ached — God listens better when flesh pays the heat.

choices.text: Bury two coins in the ice for the Third Bell
choices.preview: −2 gold · cult +1 · +1 corruption (once)
diaryTexts: The ice swallowed the gold without sound — the rumor of the bell drew closer, or my ear gave way.

choices.text: Move on

act5/camp/frost_companion_chat.title: Word Beside the Fire
act5/camp/frost_companion_chat.body:
{{companionLine}}

The wind takes the other's place when you go quiet — and still feels like an answer. The low sky helps: no one demands bravery when the cold has already collected.

choices.text: Listen to Mira without letting the snow decide for you
Sit beside Tomás — shield and storm
Stand between the two — two blades, one fire
Mira: «Still carrying the wall on your back — the cold does not forgive»
Mira: «Do your symbols melt snow? Or the other way around?»
Mira: «Well, cleric — do you pray up here or just breathe?»
Mira: «Hunter on the ice — tracking fire or flight?»
Tomás: "The ice favors those who already carry guilt in their steel"
Tomás: «Mana does not warm; it burns inside like crooked faith»
Tomás: «If the Vigil heard you now, would it approve the silence?»
Tomás: «Arrow in cutting wind — miss once and the cold remembers»
Return to the frozen camp

act5/camp/frost_duo_fireside.title: Two Blades, One Fire
act5/camp/frost_duo_fireside.body:
**Mira** and **Tomás** measure words by the fire — she wants a **name** when leaving; he straightens the shield. You are not arbiter; you are **witness**.

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Interrupt before the cold enters the conversation

act5/camp/frost_mira_fireside.title: Ice — Confidences with Mira
act5/camp/frost_mira_fireside.body:
> *"Snow **erases tracks**. Choose what you want to forget."*

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Ask if the cold returned something she lost
Speak of the summit as one speaks of a sentence
Return to the fire circle

act5/camp/frost_mira_topic_pact.title: Pact with the Cold
act5/camp/frost_mira_topic_pact.body:
> *"The cold returns nothing. It only **hardens** what stayed with you. If this is a pact, keep it **short**."*

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Let the wind close the subject

act5/camp/frost_mira_topic_summit.title: The Summit Ahead
act5/camp/frost_mira_topic_summit.body:
> *"The summit is not victory — it is **exposure**. When we climb, do not ask me for heroism. Ask for **clarity**."*

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Return to the group's relative warmth

act5/camp/frost_tomas_fireside.title: Ice — Word with Tomás
act5/camp/frost_tomas_fireside.body:
> *"Mountain is not the enemy. The enemy is **mistaking** fatigue for a sign from God."*

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Ask if the rope still hurts his palm
Speak of the temple as of a battlefield
Return to the fire circle

act5/camp/frost_tomas_topic_rope.title: The Mark of the Rope
act5/camp/frost_tomas_topic_rope.body:
> *"The rope remembers when I do not want to. If we climb together, I do not need you to save me — I need you not to invent **victory** early."*

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Let the matter close with the wind

act5/camp/frost_tomas_topic_temple.title: Temple in the Ice
act5/camp/frost_tomas_topic_temple.body:
> *"Black stone is not morals. It is **weight**. I go in first when the ground is doubtful — not for bravery, for **measure**."*

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Return to the camp's warmth
diaryTexts: Tomás spoke of the summit as a line — not glory, but duty. His shield still casts a shadow larger than he admits.
Tomás spoke of the summit as a line — duty, not glory. His shield still casts a larger shadow than he admits.

act5/camp/manage_equip.title: Buckles in the White Wind
act5/camp/manage_equip.body:
The wind sharpens every gesture. Iced steel, stiff leather straps, numb fingers.

Between gusts, you rearrange what keeps you whole: **weapon**, **armor**, whatever still answers.

choices.text: Return to the camp on the ice

act5/camp/use_consumable.title: Potions at hand
act5/camp/use_consumable.body: The cold **thickens** the flask glass. You pick what still answers — and leave the wind out of the sip.

choices.text: Drink Red Potion (self)
Give Red Potion to companion
Drink Blue Tonic (mana)
Drink Mead (stress)
Return to camp

act5/encounters/fight_ice_dragon.title: Vetrnax Awakens
act5/encounters/fight_ice_dragon.body: **Vetrnax** uncoils his neck like a thunder-rope. The first assault is not tooth — it is **cold** that steals sound from the tongue. The air vibrates before the blow.

choices.text: First phase — breath freezes the air
Fall back — return to the pass

act5/encounters/fight_ice_dragon_2.title: Silence of Ice
act5/encounters/fight_ice_dragon_2.body: The dragon **tears** his own roar and lets in a silence worse than noise. In his chest something pulses — not blood, a trapped **note**, like a choked bell.

choices.text: Drink Red Potion (self)
Give Red Potion to companion
Drink Blue Tonic (mana)
Drink Mead (stress)
Second phase — break the heart of frost

act5/encounters/frost_encounter_cultist.title: Stranger on the Ice
act5/encounters/frost_encounter_cultist.body:
Someone **sings** low — not a prayer, a rhythm that does not match the wind. His eyes already sold the sky to another bell.

Not a duel of ideas. Steel in the cold.

choices.text: Answer the cultist lost in the pass

act5/encounters/frost_encounter_howl_hor.title: Howl of the Storm
act5/encounters/frost_encounter_howl_hor.body: When the wind **turns**, you see four shapes: three whelps and a **frost raider** clearing a path like a living axe. The howl comes from metal and bone together.

choices.text: Hold the line against the horde

act5/encounters/frost_encounter_hunt_par.title: Hunting Pack
act5/encounters/frost_encounter_hunt_par.body: Three silhouettes close the ring: two frost whelps and a **fanatic** in torn cloaks, hungry for borrowed heat. The cultist whistles a rhythm that does not belong to the snow.

choices.text: Face the hunting band

act5/encounters/frost_encounter_solo_whe.title: Lost Whelp
act5/encounters/frost_encounter_solo_whe.body: A single **whelp** followed the echo of your steps — curiosity or hunger, same result. It looks at you like reading a price in a shop window: no hurry, no pity.

choices.text: Face the lone whelp

act5/encounters/frost_encounter_whelps.title: Whelps in the Blizzard
act5/encounters/frost_encounter_whelps.body: From the **white** leap two hungry silhouettes — not the quest ambush; the mountain collecting a visit. Teeth chime like glass; breath smells of rotten ice.

choices.text: Drive off the frost whelps

act5/encounters/frost_snow_mountains_com.title: Passage to the Cave Mouth
act5/encounters/frost_snow_mountains_com.body: The rumor did not fully lie: before the stone that looks like a mouth, the mountain collects a toll of teeth. Two small shadows cut the white — hunger with form.

choices.text: Cross the frost whelps guarding the path

act5/encounters/frost_stranded_traveler.title: Traveler in the Crevasse
act5/encounters/frost_stranded_traveler.body: A **mule** stuck to the ice — legs at the crevasse's mercy, white eye of panic. The owner bites his lip: *"I only need rope and someone who still believes in a path."*

choices.text: Spend rope and warmth — pull the mule to safety
choices.preview: −1 supply · +1 faith
choices.lockedHint: Without supply there is no spare rope or warmth to save — you need at least 1.
diaryTexts: The snow does not thank you — but the traveler does, with a look that asks no name.

choices.text: Cut the pack and move on before it screams
choices.preview: +6 gold · +1 corruption · Vigil −5
diaryTexts: The ice covered the scream; the gold in your pocket does not warm.

act5/encounters/frost_whelp_pack.title: Den of Frost Whelps
act5/encounters/frost_whelp_pack.body:
Two **whelps** circle you hungry for living heat. Their eyes are holes where moonlight froze — and where your reflection hesitates a second longer.

No clean exit: steel or a fall.

choices.text: Fight the frost whelps

act5/frost_epilogue.title: Frost Epilogue
act5/frost_epilogue.body:
**Vetrnax** becomes cascade; the wind stops biting. In your hand, a **scale** that burns cold — a trophy that likes to turn into guilt.

Every victory is rope. The axis still descends.

choices.text: Follow the echo under the ice — cross the Void Threshold

onEnterDiaryTexts: Vetrnax fell. The ice split like glass — and beneath, for an instant, I heard the Third Bell learning a new name.

act5/frost_hub.title: Pass — Improvised Camp
act5/frost_hub.body:
The **tents** creak in the wind; the fire spits more smoke than heat. In the snow, your tracks, beast tracks — and others the cold has already started to erase.

From here the **pass** opens into trails: patrol, rumor, summit. Below, the axis still descends. Morvayn fell at the throne; the cold does not celebrate.

act5/frost_hub_pact.title: Pass — Camp under the Bell
act5/frost_hub_pact.body:
The **tents** creak. The fire pops too low, as if waiting for a strike that is not the wind. The **ring** on your finger stays mute, but the pass goes quiet a second too early when you speak loud.

Paths remain: patrol, trade, summit. Below the axis descends. The **Third Bell** already counts your steps on the ice.

The pass stays too quiet — rumor, camp, summit. Below the axis descends. The faith you spent at the throne still weighs in the cold.

act5/frost_contrawind/intro.title: The Contrawind Mage
act5/frost_contrawind/intro.body:
The rumor does not come from a mouth. It comes from **footprints** advancing against the wind and four voices repeating the same prayer around a broken chapel.

Inside the circle of motionless snow, someone holds the air in place with a staff. The cultists call this man the **Contrawind Mage** — and close the siege.

choices.text: Follow the marks to the buried chapel
choices.preview: Four shapes surround a ward the wind has not broken yet.

choices.text: Return along the open path to the chapel
choices.preview: Snow covers the bodies, not the debt to whoever stayed inside.

choices.text: Return to the pass

act5/frost_contrawind/horde.title: Four Against the Wind
act5/frost_contrawind/horde.body:
The four **cultists** spread their formation. They are not guarding the chapel — they want to break the circle traced in the snow and reach whoever breathes inside it.

The contrawind carries the smell of iron before the blades. For one moment, none of them notices you.

choices.text: Break the siege before the chapel gives way
choices.preview: The horde has numbers; you have the first strike.

choices.text: Retreat while the tracks still lead back to camp

act5/frost_contrawind/horde_victory.title: After the Fourth Fall
act5/frost_contrawind/horde_victory.body:
The last cultist drops to his knees and the **wind** carries his prayer from his mouth. The circle remains whole; inside it, the mage erases a symbol with the tip of his staff.

> *“Edras. You opened the siege. I still need to know why.”*

The horde died. Suspicion remained standing.

choices.text: Enter the circle and speak with the mage
choices.preview: Edras lowered his staff, but not his guard.

choices.text: Return to the pass before the conversation

onEnterDiaryTexts: I broke the siege of four cultists at the buried chapel. The man inside the circle called himself Edras — and has not yet decided whether he owes me gratitude or suspicion.

act5/frost_contrawind/parley.title: Edras's Measure
act5/frost_contrawind/parley.body:
Edras does not thank you. He draws three lines between you: **strength**, **mind**, **risk**. The wind bends around each word as if it too waits for an answer.

> *“Those who ask for power usually explain the price afterward. You will explain it before. Once.”*

The staff stays low. The threat lies in the questions.

choices.text: Accept the measure — answer without hiding your intent
choices.preview: A single conversation will decide whether Edras opens the grimoire.

choices.text: Delay the answer and return to the pass

act5/frost_contrawind/accepted.title: Student of the Contrawind
act5/frost_contrawind/accepted.body:
Edras closes his eyes. When he opens them again, suspicion has lost its edge, not its weight.

> *“You did not confuse knowledge with possession. That is enough to begin.”*

The grimoire opens against the wind. Three formulas remain still on the pages: strength, lumen, apex.

choices.text: Open Edras's grimoire
choices.preview: Three lessons, twelve coins per page learned.

choices.text: Return to the pass with the invitation

onEnterDiaryTexts: Edras accepted the measure of my intentions and opened the Contrawind grimoire. The lessons are not gifts: each costs twelve coins and a choice in battle.

act5/frost_contrawind/rejected.title: The Closed Grimoire
act5/frost_contrawind/rejected.body:
Edras wipes away the three lines with the sole of his boot. The circle lets the wind in, and the grimoire's pages close before you read a single formula.

> *“You defeated the horde. You did not defeat what you would do with the lesson. I will not ask again.”*

The chapel remains on the ice. The conversation does not.

choices.text: Leave Edras and return to the pass

onEnterDiaryTexts: Edras refused to open the grimoire. The measure was taken once; the chapel remains open, but his answer does not.

act5/frost_contrawind/merchant.title: Lessons of the Contrawind
act5/frost_contrawind/merchant.body:
Edras keeps the grimoire open with one hand. In the other, he weighs each coin as if searching for a lie struck into the metal.

> *“The lesson changes a battle, not who you are. If you need to cast it to believe otherwise, keep the gold.”*

Three formulas wait. After them, Edras still has words — **not stock**.

choices.preview: Universal spell · +2 STR until combat ends; does not stack.
choices.lockedHint: You need 12 gold.

choices.text: Learn Inner Lumen (−12 gold)
choices.preview: Universal spell · +2 MIND until combat ends; does not stack.
choices.lockedHint: You need 12 gold.

choices.text: Learn Apex Eye (−12 gold)
choices.preview: Universal spell · +10% critical chance until combat ends; does not stack.
choices.lockedHint: You need 12 gold.

choices.text: Ask Edras about the wind that teaches
choices.preview: The stock ends. The questions do not.

choices.text: Close the grimoire and return to the pass

act5/frost_lair_approach.title: Approach to the Ice Lair
act5/frost_lair_approach.body:
**Ice** mirrors the face in slices — none whole. Below, winter teeth open a smile that is not for you.

The air turns to needles; the sky drops too low.

choices.text: Enter the chamber of white breath
Turn your face to the wind — the gray trail waits
choices.preview: Verbal confrontation with Kael (draft); failure leads to steel.

choices.text: Return to camp

onEnterDiaryTexts: The lair does not smell of brimstone — it smells of deferred storm. Vetrnax sleeps awake.

act5/frost_merchant.title: Frost Merchant's Tent
act5/frost_merchant.body:
Inside the tent, flasks **tremble**. The merchant shows no face — only prices that do not freeze.

> Stock **limited**. The wind charges hard for those who bargain too long.

choices.text: Buy Red Potion (5 gold) (×2)
Buy Red Potion (5 gold) (×1)
Buy Blue Tonic (10 gold) (×1)
Buy Mead (4 gold) (×1)
Buy Supply (5 gold) (×2)
Buy Supply (5 gold) (×1)
Buy Supply (10 gold) (×1)

choices.lockedHint: Requires 15 gold, level 26+, and the three prior supplies.

choices.preview: Weapon · damage and agility
choices.lockedHint: Requires 9 gold.

choices.preview: Armor · light, with mind
choices.lockedHint: Requires 8 gold.

choices.text: Vigil field kit (−7 gold)
choices.preview: Supply · Vigil seal (once at this stall)

choices.text: Step away from the tent

act5/frost_monk/banished.title: The Cave Closes
act5/frost_monk/banished.body:
The cave **refuses** you — narrow air, dry voice: *go back where you can still lie with comfort.*

The mountain pushes you out. **There is no return** to that mouth.

choices.text: Descend alone — the mountain does not argue

onEnterDiaryTexts: I failed in the monk's cave. The wind pushed me out — and I heard the stone close from inside. There is no second entrance.

act5/frost_monk/trial_agi.title: Third Question — Body on the Ice of Decision
act5/frost_monk/trial_agi.body:
Plates under the boots lie about firmness — *do not speak; **take** a step without betraying balance; who stumbles vanishes.*

Courage without precision is haste. The cave does not forgive haste.

act5/frost_monk/trial_luck.title: Second Question — What Cannot Be Controlled
act5/frost_monk/trial_luck.body:
A low **laugh**, frost cracking: *now it is not an idea — it is **fall** and **luck**.*

The cave tilts; the next step may be yours or belonging to whoever believed too much.
act5/frost_monk/trial_luck.luckCheckLabel: Accept chance without lying to your body (Luck)

act5/frost_monk/trial_mind.title: First Question — The Weight of Thought
act5/frost_monk/trial_mind.body:
Faceless shadow, only quiet habit — *say a truth you **hate** knowing.*

The cave does not punish failure: it **closes**. Roll the skill check when ready.
act5/frost_monk/trial_mind.skillCheckLabel: Listen to the end without your mind fleeing (Mind)

act5/frost_monk/triumph.title: Blessing of Quiet Snow
act5/frost_monk/triumph.body:
The monk **bows** his head — *do not take me; take this: the world throws dice, and you learned to look without asking for a trick.*

Something settles in the chest: **+1 LCK**, and the cave lets you leave.

choices.text: Return to the pass — carry the silence in your chest

onEnterDiaryTexts: In the cave above the storm, a faceless monk gave me a strange blessing: not promise, not miracle — only the certainty that luck can also be discipline. I gained the Inner Peace passive: +1 LCK, forever.

act5/frost_opening.title: Graywind Heights
act5/frost_opening.body:
All of **Cimeria** seems covered in snow — white rooftops, fields without outline, roads vanished under ice. The **cold** enters the chest and locks your breath.

On the **Graywind Heights**, the wind cuts the mouth. From shelter to shelter, rumor of **Vetrnax**: dragon on the summit, breath that freezes the cry before sound.

Morvayn fell to iron. The **axis** still descends. Thin victory; ice without mercy.

choices.text: Climb down from the gap — see how Cimeria fared

onEnterDiaryTexts: After the throne: all of Cimeria in snow, dungeon air. Vetrnax rumor in the Heights.

act5/frost_opening_pact.title: Graywind Heights — under the Bell
act5/frost_opening_pact.body:
All of **Cimeria** seems covered in snow — white rooftops, fields without outline. The **cold** enters the chest; the **Third Bell** throbs under the skin and warms nothing.

On the **Heights**, the wind cuts the mouth. Rumor of **Vetrnax** runs from shelter to shelter — dragon on the summit, breath that freezes the cry before sound.

**Corruption** climbs with every step. The pass goes quiet when you breathe too loud.

choices.text: Climb down from the gap — see how Cimeria fared

onEnterDiaryTexts: After the throne: all of Cimeria in snow, dungeon air. The Third Bell climbs with me. Vetrnax rumor in the Heights.

act5/frost_opening_sealed.title: Graywind Heights — under the Seal
act5/frost_opening_sealed.body:
All of **Cimeria** seems covered in snow — white rooftops, fields without outline. The **cold** enters the chest and reminds you of the **weight** of the seal you carry.

On the **Heights**, the wind cuts the mouth. Rumor of **Vetrnax** runs from shelter to shelter — dragon on the summit, breath that freezes the cry before sound.

You sealed the hole with **faith**. The undercroft is quiet; peace under the sky is fragile as thin ice.

choices.text: Climb down from the gap — see how Cimeria fared

onEnterDiaryTexts: After the throne: all of Cimeria in snow, dungeon air. I sealed the dungeon with faith. Vetrnax rumor in the Heights.

act5/frost_cimeria_snow.title: Cimeria in White
act5/frost_cimeria_snow.body:
You leave the **ice gap**. All of **Cimeria** seems covered in snow now — rooftops without smoke, sealed wells, harvest buried.

The **cold** enters through the armor seams. Below, the village you remember is a white smudge; above, the pass climbs toward gray wind.

choices.text: [>] Scan Cimeria from afar
choices.preview: Mind check — read what the snow hid.

choices.text: [%] Follow the movement in the snow
choices.preview: Introductory combat — curious ice whelp.

choices.text: Follow the pass — toward the Heights

onEnterDiaryTexts: I climbed from the throne and Cimeria was another place: snow as far as the eye reaches. The village vanished into a white blur.

act5/frost_cimeria_snow_scout.title: A Distant Look
act5/frost_cimeria_snow_scout.body: You stop on the **snow ledge**. Below — roof, well, wall — all the same and all different. The **cold** fogs your sight; you must decide what is still shape and what is already silence.
act5/frost_cimeria_snow_scout.skillCheckLabel: Read the white blur — what changed in Cimeria

act5/frost_cimeria_snow_scout_ok.title: Frost Map
act5/frost_cimeria_snow_scout_ok.body:
You recognize **three** signs: wells capped with ice, rooftops without smoke, the market trail erased. This is not ordinary winter — all of **Cimeria** covered in white, as if someone closed the world's door.

Rumor of **Vetrnax** rises from the valley without climbing the slope. The **cold** confirms: the dragon is not just tavern lore.

choices.text: Keep what you saw and move on

onEnterDiaryTexts: From afar I saw Cimeria buried: sealed wells, rooftops without smoke, the market trail gone. The green did not return — only snow.

act5/frost_cimeria_snow_scout_fail.title: Snow Without Outline
act5/frost_cimeria_snow_scout_fail.body:
The snow **swallows** contour — village becomes smudge, smudge becomes doubt. You lose time and heat trying to see what the ice refuses to show.

The **cold** enters through the gloves. Rumor of **Vetrnax** remains below, without proof.

choices.text: Look away and move on

onEnterDiaryTexts: I stayed too long on the ledge; the cold got to my fingers before my sight did.

act5/frost_cimeria_snow_whelp.title: Whelp on the Slope
act5/frost_cimeria_snow_whelp.body:
Something **shifts** in fresh snow — not wind, not stone. An ice **whelp** lifts its snout; its breath freezes before it reaches you.

Curiosity or hunger: the result is the same on the pass.

choices.text: Face the curious whelp

act5/frost_cimeria_snow_whelp_win.title: Blood That Freezes Fast
act5/frost_cimeria_snow_whelp_win.body:
The **whelp** falls; the ice drinks the fight's heat in an instant. On the ground, small **tracks** cross others — much larger — toward the summit.

The **cold** warns: this was only the beginning.

choices.text: Move on — the pass will not wait

onEnterDiaryTexts: First ice whelp on the road to the Heights. Its trail pointed upward — toward larger tracks.

act5/frost_heights_rumors.title: Echoes on the Ice
act5/frost_heights_rumors.body:
On a stone, someone scratched with a nail: *they tied the squire*. Farther on, thin smoke — **tent** or trap.

Large **tracks** cross the snow toward the summit; locals murmur **Vetrnax** without saying the name. They also speak of a **monk** in a cave above the storm, and **black stone** on the peak.

You confirm nothing. The **cold** carries the words anyway.

choices.text: [>] Decipher the marks on the stone
choices.preview: Mind check — assemble the map from scratched clues.

choices.text: [~] Listen to the wind between the shelters
choices.preview: Luck check — catch the Vetrnax rumor before it goes quiet.

choices.text: [%] Confront the singing in the smoke
choices.preview: Introductory combat — frost cultist on the pass.

choices.text: Go to the improvised camp in the pass
choices.preview: Weak fire, shelter, and rumors that become missions.

onEnterDiaryTexts: On the ice, crossed voices: tied squire, monk in a cave, claws on the summit, blue-thunder tent. Vetrnax in every whisper.

act5/frost_heights_rumors_clues.title: Marks on the Ice
act5/frost_heights_rumors_clues.body: The nail **tore** more than letters — it tore hurry. You tilt your head: abbreviations, arrows, names cut short by the **cold**.
act5/frost_heights_rumors_clues.skillCheckLabel: Decipher what someone scratched on the stone

act5/frost_heights_rumors_clues_ok.title: Crossed Clues
act5/frost_heights_rumors_clues_ok.body:
You assemble the **map** in the marks: **Tomás** tied to the east; **monk** in a cave above the storm; **blue-thunder tent** farther on; **black stone** on the summit. Every arrow points to **Vetrnax** without writing the name.

The clues match what the wind whispered — now you have direction.

choices.text: Note it and keep moving on the ice

onEnterDiaryTexts: On the stone: squire tied to the east, monk above the storm, blue-thunder tent in the pass, black-stone temple on the summit. Vetrnax in every arrow.

act5/frost_heights_rumors_clues_fail.title: Frozen Letters
act5/frost_heights_rumors_clues_fail.body:
The frost **repainted** half the letters. What remains looks like accusation — or a crooked map.

Rumor of **Vetrnax** stays in the air, without coordinates. The **cold** likes it when you hesitate.

choices.text: Give up the reading and move on

onEnterDiaryTexts: The marks on the stone mixed with new ice; only the fear of choosing wrong remained.

act5/frost_heights_rumors_listen.title: Voices in the Wind
act5/frost_heights_rumors_listen.body: Between rock and **snow**, someone speaks low — or the wind imitates voice. You hold your breath: if you listen too long, the **cold** enters with it.
act5/frost_heights_rumors_listen.luckCheckLabel: Hear the rumor between the shelters before the ice swallows it

act5/frost_heights_rumors_listen_ok.title: Name Without a Mouth
act5/frost_heights_rumors_listen_ok.body:
You catch **one whole sentence** before the wind cuts it: *"… the breath freezes the cry…"* — not poetry. A warning about **Vetrnax**.

The **cold** at your neck confirms. All of Cimeria seems to hear the same name.

choices.text: Keep the rumor and move on

onEnterDiaryTexts: I heard locals murmur Vetrnax — dragon on the summit, breath that freezes the cry before sound. No one said it aloud; everyone knew.

act5/frost_heights_rumors_listen_fail.title: Mute Wind
act5/frost_heights_rumors_listen_fail.body:
The wind **becomes a wall**. You lose heat waiting for words that do not return.

Rumor of **Vetrnax** stays in the stomach, not the ear.

choices.text: Move on before you freeze for good

onEnterDiaryTexts: I listened until the cold ate my warmth — and the rumor was lost in the gray wind.

act5/frost_heights_rumors_cultist.title: Singing in the Smoke
act5/frost_heights_rumors_cultist.body:
The **smoke** does not come from a hearth — it comes from frozen incense. Someone **sings** low, frost rhythm, eyes sold to another bell.

This is not a duel of ideas. It is steel in the **cold**.

choices.text: Confront whoever sings in the thin smoke

act5/frost_heights_rumors_cultist_win.title: Incense That Freezes
act5/frost_heights_rumors_cultist_win.body:
The **cultist** falls; the incense turns to crystal in the air. Under the robe, a scratched map: arrow **east**, the word *squire*.

The ice missions stop being rumor — they start having an **address**.

choices.text: Head toward camp

onEnterDiaryTexts: Frost cultist on the pass — singing before steel. Under the robe, a scratched map pointing east: tied squire.

act5/frost_ridgeline.title: Ridge of the Frozen Range
act5/frost_ridgeline.body:
The **ridge** does not welcome — blade-air, short breath in the chest.

A distant **crack** — ice splitting under impossible weight; **tracks** that are not human.

choices.text: Follow the claw trail in the snow
Return to camp

onEnterDiaryTexts: The snow does not lie: something large slid here. And something small still lurks.

act5/frost_snow_gruta_approach.title: Stone Mouth and Warm Breath
act5/frost_snow_gruta_approach.body:
The mouth **swallows**; inside, warm air that makes the ice lie about temperature.

An echo asks: *who brings noise to a place that only wants quiet?*

choices.text: Enter the cave — accept what inside asks no permission

act5/frost_snow_mountains_enter.title: Ascent to the Snow Mountains
act5/frost_snow_mountains_enter.body:
Above the line where the **storm** goes quiet, they say a **cave** breathes — a trail only in whispers and in those who came back **halfway** from there.

Snow underfoot creaks. You decide whether to enter.

choices.text: Follow the rumor — climb until the wind goes quiet

act5/frost_summit/ascend.title: Trail to the Summit
act5/frost_summit/ascend.body:
The **ridge** sharpens into basalt teeth — a path the body collects in short breath and quiet fear.

At the **summit**, those who returned halfway say, there is black stone and a temple that asks for no prayer.

choices.text: Follow the line of stone that bites the sky

onEnterDiaryTexts: I climbed where the map ends. The wind here does not apologize — it demands witnesses.

act5/frost_summit/encounters/fallen_god_.title: The Throne Answers
act5/frost_summit/encounters/fallen_god_.body: An old **noise** — not thunder, memory with teeth — tears the air. From the altar rises a form that was a number before it had a face: echoes of what slept under the gods.

choices.text: Face what descended from the pantheon

act5/frost_summit/encounters/fallen_god_.title: Curse of the Throne
act5/frost_summit/encounters/fallen_god_.body:
Defeat does not come only as a **wound**. It comes as shape — a hand on the inner mirror pulling you down on three fronts: body, reflection, will.

Carry the weight. The temple does not return what it ate.

choices.text: Drag myself out of the temple — alive, but hollow

onEnterDiaryTexts: I lost to the echo — and the temple left me a curse that is not confessed, only carried.

act5/frost_summit/encounters/fallen_god_.title: Fallen God
act5/frost_summit/encounters/fallen_god_.body: Silence after the fall is not comfort. It is a contract read low. Something in you keeps the wrong name in the right place: **fallen god** — a title that burns cold.

choices.text: Leave the summit — with the new weight in your chest

onEnterDiaryTexts: I defeated a pantheon echo. The title does not warm — but the amulet burns where corruption bites.

act5/frost_summit/encounters/path_1.title: First Blockade
act5/frost_summit/encounters/path_1.body: The ice **lies**: it looks like silence, but it is an ambush with claws. A **raider** made this pass a home — and a **whelp** still learns to eat fear.

choices.text: Force the ascent — cross the first blockade

act5/frost_summit/encounters/path_2.title: Second Blockade
act5/frost_summit/encounters/path_2.body: The air **thins** until it cuts. A **cultist** sings a rhythm that does not match the snow; beside him, the **raider** drags metal — warning, not music.

choices.text: Climb higher — the wind worsens before it stills

act5/frost_summit/encounters/path_3.title: Last Pass
act5/frost_summit/encounters/path_3.body: Here the wind does not push — it **tears**. Several **whelps** circle like a bad idea made flesh; the **cultist** laughs low, as if he already read your end in a dead tongue.

choices.text: Break the circle — the summit is above

act5/frost_summit/pick_sacrifice.title: Who Pays the Price
act5/frost_summit/pick_sacrifice.body:
The **altar** does not shine; it absorbs. To open what sleeps under the "**ancient gods**", someone stops being people — and someone pays in near flesh.

Choose with a cold chest. The temple accepts no excuse.

choices.text: Offer Mira to the altar — no theater, no return
choices.preview: Without carrying the gesture in time, you retreat to the threshold.

choices.text: Offer Tomás to the altar — oath broken in blood
choices.preview: Without carrying the gesture in time, you retreat to the threshold.

choices.text: I cannot — return to the threshold
choices.preview: Offer your own body (Lose half max HP forever)

onEnterDiaryTexts: The altar asks no name. It asks presence. And I chose who would stay absent.

act5/frost_summit/ritual_altar.title: The Altar That Learns Your Name
act5/frost_summit/ritual_altar.body:
At the threshold the cold seemed weather; here it is a fence — black stone that opens only for those who came to translate silence.

The **altar** does not ask for prayer. It asks for a **price**.

choices.text: Proceed — blood in the ritual, without pretending innocence
choices.preview: Choose who stays outside humanity.

act5/frost_summit/ritual_blood.title: Invocation in Blood
act5/frost_summit/ritual_blood.body:
Blood **darkens** the snow; the air smells of iron and a broken oath — in the temple, something wakes by contract, not blessing.

**Three seals** — Mind, body, name. The rest is blood.

act5/frost_summit/ritual_pacified.title: Seals Closed
act5/frost_summit/ritual_pacified.body:
For an **instant** — long enough to hurt — the temple goes truly quiet. Not peace; a deal forced on something that preferred hunger.

Corruption steps back once. The cold continues.

choices.text: Accept the gods' retreat — and leave

onEnterDiaryTexts: The seals closed in time. I felt the void recede — not as victory, as truce.

act5/frost_summit/temple_gate.title: Threshold of the Black Stone Temple
act5/frost_summit/temple_gate.body:
At the **summit**, time does not pass — it piles up. Broken pillars hold a roof that no longer protects anything, only witnesses. The cold tastes metallic.

If you enter, enter awake.

choices.text: Descend to the pass — the body asks for less altitude
Only contemplate the silence between the pillars
Approach the temple heart — where silence weighs like a slab
choices.preview: Go to the altar at the temple's depths — and understand what the ritual demands.
choices.lockedHint: You need corruption 7 or higher and at least one companion in the party.

act5/frost_summit/temple_quiet.title: Silence of Stone
act5/frost_summit/temple_quiet.body:
Between **pillars**, snow falls straight and slow. No music; only cold stone and the sound of your breath.

Comfort does not live here. If you came for **truth**, find the warning before comfort.

choices.text: Return to the threshold

onEnterDiaryTexts: In the temple, silence does not console — it weighs.

act5/frost_tomas/encounters/fight_adv.title: Advantage in the Clearing
act5/frost_tomas/encounters/fight_adv.body: You reach the **clearing** in shadow — a **whelp** sniffing wrong wind; a **cultist** with a knife at **Tomás**'s neck. Tomás closes his eyes to count, not for faith.

choices.text: Strike before the blade wakes

act5/frost_tomas/encounters/fight_hard.title: The Ice Does Not Forgive
act5/frost_tomas/encounters/fight_hard.body: A **crack** under the boot — too early. The **cultist** lifts his face; the **whelp** hisses; **Tomás** pulls the stuck shield, still alive. Only wrong light between you and steel.

choices.text: Answer the clash even without surprise

act5/frost_tomas/intro.title: The Squire in the Snow
act5/frost_tomas/intro.body:
Among the rocks, **Tomás** is tied to an ice post; two frost **cultists** measure time with blade and prayer.

Not romance. A rope debt — and time is running.

choices.text: Follow the rumor to the bottom of the clearing
choices.preview: Listen to the ice — or hesitate and return to the pass.

choices.text: Return to the pass

act5/frost_tomas/missed.title: Empty Rope
act5/frost_tomas/missed.body:
The rope **hits** the post; no Tomás — only absence and a mark in the snow that is not yours.

An echo murmurs that those who linger below pay in someone else's flesh.

choices.text: Return to the pass

onEnterDiaryTexts: I arrived late to the squire's rumor: only rope hitting the post. No Tomás.

act5/frost_tomas/rescued.title: The Shield Rises
act5/frost_tomas/rescued.body:
The rope **snaps**; **Tomás** drops to his knees in the snow and raises the shield before his face — not to hide, to **swear**.

> *"Order me to rise, I rise. If not, I walk with you."*

The **stake** stands empty. For the first time since the **Heights**, someone chooses to stay **at your side**.

choices.text: Return to the pass

onEnterDiaryTexts: I pulled Tomás from the rope and the ritual. His shield still trembles — but he swore to follow whoever does not flee first.

act5/frost_tomas/trial.title: Trial of the Trail
act5/frost_tomas/trial.body:
**Snow** hides sound, not the trail — leg and judgment, or the **cultist** turns his head and the **whelp** wakes hungry for panic.

**Tomás** bites the rope and waits for your step.
act5/frost_tomas/trial.skillCheckLabel: Approach without the wind selling you out
